decisions.reason: Despite its flagship status, two years without any observable market presence suggests the strategic option has not realized value, so it should be abandoned.
The foldable large container's dedicated page did not lead to sustained visibility, indicating the option has not gained enough traction to justify continued investment.
As a less differentiated stackable crate with no positive signal, its option value is low and keeping costs are no longer justified.
The medium-duty rackable pallet has shown no evidence of demand, so the option should be closed to free resources.
Environmental-compliance demand has not materialized, making the spill-retention pallet's option unlikely to pay off.
The differentiated load-retainer feature has not kept the product visible, indicating declining option value that warrants abandonment.
